name: Garika Rosa Starnis
original_name: ガリカ・ローサ・スターニス
source:
The daughter of the Starnis family, famous in the world of magic. She is not very good at magic, though. Under the guidance of her outstanding older brother Fin, she is admitted to an elite magic academy, The Oriens Academy, but is shocked to find that she is now surrounded by students who are even more talented than she had ever imagined. So she tries her best to keep up with them. Her brother Fin dotes on her and she loves him very much too. She has a secret that she cannot tell anyone.

‘That’s right, I cannot do anything else besides looking down.’

[Translated from [url=http://www.daisy-daisy.in/products/majyu/]the official website[/url].]
